rows.text: Ruling in the Lok Sabha on 28 May 1996 on when a Prime Minister is recognised as Leader of the House, the Speaker says that in the Tenth Lok Sabha the P. V. Narasimha Rao Government was sworn in on 21 June 1991, and refers to 'the day the Prime Minister took oath, that is, 21st of June 1991'.

locator.item: Speaker's ruling on the recognition of the Leader of the House
